usage: `OpenGL.MaxSubDataSize=<值>` / `OpenGL.MaxSubDataSize <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Maximum amount of data to send to glBufferSubData in one call

usage: `OpenGL.RebindTextureBuffers=<值>` / `OpenGL.RebindTextureBuffers <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If true, rebind GL_TEXTURE_BUFFER's to their GL_TEXTURE name whenever the buffer is modified.

usage: `OpenGL.SkipCompute=<值>` / `OpenGL.SkipCompute <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If true, don't issue dispatch work.

usage: `OpenGL.UBODirectWrite=<值>` / `OpenGL.UBODirectWrite <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Enables direct writes to the UBO via Buffer Storage

usage: `OpenGL.UBOPoolSize=<值>` / `OpenGL.UBOPoolSize <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Size of the UBO pool, 0 disables UBO Pool

usage: `OpenGL.UseBufferDiscard=<值>` / `OpenGL.UseBufferDiscard <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If true, use dynamic buffer orphaning hint.

usage: `OpenGL.UseGlClipControlIfAvailable=<值>` / `OpenGL.UseGlClipControlIfAvailable <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If true, the engine trys to use glClipControl if the driver supports it.

usage: `OpenGL.UseMapBuffer=<值>` / `OpenGL.UseMapBuffer <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If true, use glMapBuffer otherwise use glBufferSubdata.

usage: `OpenGL.UsePersistentMappingStagingBuffer=<值>` / `OpenGL.UsePersistentMappingStagingBuffer <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If true, it will use persistent mapping for the Staging Buffer.

usage: `OpenGL.UseStagingBuffer=<值>` / `OpenGL.UseStagingBuffer <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Enables maps of dynamic vertex buffers to go to a staging buffer

usage: `OpenGL.UseUnsynchronizedBufferMapping=<值>` / `OpenGL.UseUnsynchronizedBufferMapping <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If true, use GL_MAP_UNSYNCHRONIZED_BIT when mapping write only buffers.
